title: Social Media Marketing Agency in New York City
metaTitle: Social Media Marketing Agency in New York City | TDM
metaDescription: Social media management for New York City businesses: strategy, content calendars, daily posting, community replies and paid social. Free consultation.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) runs social media for New York City businesses from strategy through daily management. We plan the calendar, produce and edit the content, post, reply to comments and messages, and run paid social where it helps. New Yorkers use Instagram and TikTok to decide where to eat, shop and train, so for many businesses here the feed does the job a shop window used to do.

sections.heading: How New Yorkers use social media to choose
paragraphs: A new bakery in the West Village or a dumpling counter in Flushing can have a queue outside within days of a few well-watched videos. People save posts into lists for later, send them to friends and check an account's latest uploads before they travel across town. An account that has not posted for two months reads as a business that may have closed.

The audience is also unusually exposed to good content. Fashion labels, media companies and agencies based here set a high bar, and a stock graphic with a slogan gets scrolled past. What holds attention is specific and real: the dish being plated, the fitting room, the view from the rooftop, the owner explaining why the shop exists.

Professional firms meet their buyers elsewhere. Finance, law, consulting and technology people in the city are active on LinkedIn, where a partner's clear post on a narrow subject does more than a company page full of announcements.

sections.heading: What we manage for you
paragraphs: You approve a monthly calendar; we handle the rest. Reporting covers reach, engagement, traffic and, where ads run, cost per result and revenue.
bullets: A channel plan: which platforms, what subjects, how often, and what each post is meant to achieve.
Content creation: graphics, captions and short-form video edited for Reels, TikTok and Shorts.
Daily posting and account management across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X and Pinterest as needed.
Community management: comments, direct messages and reviews answered promptly in your voice.
Paid social on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn to put proven posts in front of a defined local audience.

sections.heading: Where the footage comes from
paragraphs: Our team in the United States films and photographs for the calendar: the room before service, a class in progress, new arrivals on the rail, products in use. The clips and images then go to our operations office in Lahore, where they are edited, captioned and designed into posts. Material your own staff capture between shoots is welcome too, and we cut and schedule it alongside the rest. Before we start, we agree who films what and how often, so the calendar never depends on footage that does not exist.

sections.heading: Planning around the city's year
paragraphs: Content lands better when it follows what people are already doing. The winter holidays bring window displays, gift guides and visitors. Restaurant Week, the fashion weeks, marathon weekend, summer street fairs and rooftop season each give local businesses something timely to post about. Neighbourhood identity matters as well: a cafe in Bed-Stuy and one in Tribeca speak to different crowds, and their feeds should not look interchangeable.

cards.heading: Who we run social media for in New York

items.title: Restaurants, bars and cafes
items.text: Regular short video of food and room, quick replies to booking questions, and paid boosts limited to people nearby.

items.title: Boutiques and fashion labels
items.text: New arrivals, styling clips and drop announcements, linked to an online store so interest turns into orders.

items.title: Fitness and wellness studios
items.text: Class previews, instructor introductions and member stories that give newcomers a reason to try a first session.

items.title: Real estate agents
items.text: Walk-through clips and neighbourhood notes that keep an agent visible between listings.

items.title: Professional and B2B firms
items.text: LinkedIn content plans for partners and company pages, built around a named area of expertise.

presence: TDM has no office in New York City. Planning, posting and community management are done online with a shared calendar you approve. Filming and photography are handled by our team in the United States, and editing and design by our operations office in Lahore.

faqs.q: Which social platforms matter most for a New York City business?
faqs.a: For food, retail, beauty and fitness, Instagram and TikTok carry the most weight. For professional services and B2B, LinkedIn is usually the priority. We recommend a mix after looking at who your customers are and where they already engage with similar businesses.

faqs.q: Who films the content for our New York accounts?
faqs.a: Our team in the United States films and photographs what the calendar needs, and editing and design are done at our operations office in Lahore. Clips your staff capture day to day can be added to the mix.

faqs.q: Do we need paid ads, or is organic posting enough?
faqs.a: Organic posting builds trust and gives people something to check before they visit. Paid social reaches people who do not follow you yet. In a market as crowded as New York, a modest paid budget behind your strongest posts usually makes the organic work go further.

faqs.q: How often should a local business post?
faqs.a: Often enough to look active and current, at a pace you can sustain with real material. We set the frequency in the plan based on the platforms chosen and how much real material the business generates.

faqs.q: How much does social media management cost in NYC?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of channels, the volume of content and whether paid campaigns are included. We quote after a free consultation.
